integrity: Analytical self-contained generator and Jensen proof; independent scientific validation has not been performed.
scientific_limitations: Rotation-invariant stationary ensemble for reflection-symmetric relative-angle jumps. No uniqueness of orientation stationary law for all atomic turning measures; no chiral increments, full density or distributional CLT. First two harmonics only. Right-angle special case established in 2022.
title: Sharp fourth-moment envelope for correlated-turn swimmers in a harmonic trap
